signals.title: Honda Forza 750, two new colour options are available
signals.summary: Using the same strategy adopted for the 2027 X-ADV 750 and NC750X, Honda has refreshed the Forza 750 with nothing more than an updated colour range. Specifically, the flagship model of the Forza family gains two new colour options. Alongside the returning Mat Warm Ash Metallic, customers can now choose the new Gunmetal Black Metallic , featuring an all-black look, and the elegant Mat Iridium Gray Metallic . From a technical point of view, the Forza 750 remains unchanged since the introduction of the 2025 model year. It can be identified by its headlight with integrated LED daytime running lights and turn indicators. Behind the electrically adjustable windscreen sits a 5-inch full-colour TFT display with Honda RoadSync connectivity. Standard equipment includes cruise control, three-level traction control and five riding modes to manage the 58.6 hp produced by the engine, paired with Honda's Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT). The new Forza 750 is also available in a restricted version for A2 licence holders. The chassis package continues to feature a tubular steel frame, an upside-down front fork, a Pro-Link rear suspension with aluminium swingarm, 17-inch front and 15-inch rear wheels, and radially mounted brake calipers. Under the seat there is enough storage space for a full-face helmet, while a USB socket is conveniently positioned on the handlebar. © Copyright 2023 Esposizione internazionale del ciclo, motociclo, accessori S.p.A. in sigla E.I.C.M.A. S.p.A - Privacy Policy - C

signals.title: Kappa expands its rider lineup with two smart accessories
signals.summary: With the KPM1 and KBH50 , Kappa is enriching its lineup of universal gear for motorcycles and scooters, offering two practical solutions engineered for both daily commuting and long-haul adventures. The first novelty, the KPM1 , lets riders securely mount their smartphone to handlebars ranging from 22 to 32 mm in diameter, ensuring rock-solid stability on the move. Compact and light, this new smartphone mount features a reinforced nylon chassis with TPU side inserts designed to absorb vibrations and impacts. A quick-detach mechanism makes mounting or removing the phone a breeze, while the adjustable cradle accommodates devices from 65 to 90 mm wide. The second highlight from Kappa is the KBH50 bottle holder . Crafted from a blend of reinforced nylon, silicone, and steel, its design guarantees a firm grip on any tubular bar, fitting motorcycles, scooters, and e-bikes alike. It can securely cradle bottles and flasks with diameters between 32 and 77 mm, and the non-slip silicone interior lining keeps everything locked in place even when tackling bumpy terrain. Additionally, interlocking gears allow for precise angle adjustments in both horizontal and vertical setups. © Copyright 2023 Esposizione internazionale del ciclo, motociclo, accessori S.p.A. in sigla E.I.C.M.A. S.p.A - Privacy Policy - Cookie Policy - Condizioni Generali Sede legale: Via Fabio Filzi 25/a, 20124 Milano - Pi e cf: 04145450153 N° iscrizione 04145450153 - Capitale sociale sottoscritto e versato: 100.000 euro

signals.title: MODENAS INTRODUCES ENHANCED Z15GT AND REFRESHED ELIT 150S WITH NEW COLOURS AND...
signals.summary: Z15GT gains seven product improvements and two new colourways, while ELIT 150S receives three product updates with three refreshed options SHAH ALAM, 10 September 2026 – Motosikal dan Enjin Nasional Sdn Bhd (“MODENAS”), a member of the DRB-HICOM Group, is introducing a series of product improvements alongside new colours and graphics for the MODENAS Z15GT and MODENAS ELIT 150S. All new Z15GT units featuring the latest colours and graphics incorporate the full suite of enhancements introduced through the Z15GT Care Programme, reflecting MODENAS’ commitment to continuous product development. The latest Z15GT specification incorporates seven targeted improvements , including enhanced drainage for the overflow tray; additional coating and sealant protection for the ignition knob switch; a revised injector cap bolt and collar design; a low-level indicator line for the front brake lever; reinforced side-cover snap fittings; additional socket covers to improve wire-harness protection against water exposure; and protective treatment for solder points within the left and right switch assemblies. The Z15GT is now available in Lime Green and Amazon Green . Drawing inspiration from Kawasaki’s signature colour identity, Lime Green delivers a bolder, sportier look, while Amazon Green offers a distinctive alternative. signals.summary: Review Innova Zenix Hybrid Pemakaian 2 Tahun: Ini Plus Minus Varian Q JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Toyota Innova Zenix menjadi salah satu Multi-Purpose Vehicle (MPV) andalan PT Toyota-Astra Motor (TAM) di pasar otomotif Tanah Air. Rentang harga yang luas serta pilihan varian yang beragam membuat konsumen memiliki banyak opsi sesuai kebutuhan. Michael, pemilik Toyota Innova Zenix tipe Q Hybrid Modellista keluaran 2024, membagikan pengalamannya selama dua tahun menggunakan kendaraan tersebut sebagai mobil harian. Ia mengungkapkan sejumlah kelebihan dan kekurangan yang dirasakannya selama masa kepemilikan. Efisiensinya sangat irit, bisa mencapai 18 19 km/liter. Tenaganya juga lumayan kencang untuk ukuran mobil sebesar ini, ujar Michael kepada Kompas.com, Minggu (20/9/2026). Selain sektor dapur pacu, sisi akomodasi dan kenyamanan interior juga mendapat apresiasi. Kabin yang amat lapang serta praktis dinilai sangat ramah untuk kebutuhan keluarga ( family friendly ). Michael kemudian memberikan beberapa catatan minus untuk varian tertinggi dari keluarga Zenix ini. signals.title: Veda Ega Usai Moto3 Austria: Saya Merasa Hanya Normal Overtake
signals.summary: Veda Ega Usai Moto3 Austria: Saya Merasa Hanya Normal Overtake JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com Pebalap Indonesia Veda Ega Pratama mengaku tidak merasa melakukan manuver secara berlebihan saat menjalani Moto3 Austria 2026 di Sirkuit Red Bull Ring, Minggu (20/9/2026). Pernyataan tersebut disampaikan Veda setelah dirinya mendapat double long lap penalty yang membuat peluang meraih hasil lebih tinggi pada Moto3 Austria 2026 sirna. Veda mengaku sempat melakukan kontak dengan pebalap lain selama balapan. Namun, dia merasa manuver yang dilakukan masih dalam batas normal. Baca juga: Drama Veda Ega Pratama di Moto3 Austria, Sempat di Posisi 4 "Alhamdulillah saya bisa finis di zona poin lagi di posisi 13. Jalannya balapan saya hanya mencoba untuk start bagus dan mencoba untuk improve di setiap lap-nya dan ya akhirnya saya bisa fight , sempat di posisi empat," kata Veda, dikutip dari SPOTV, Minggu (20/9/2026). "Selama jalannya balapan saya memang normal dalam balapan ada kontak dengan rider lain dan saya harus dikenakan long lap di tiga lap terakhir, tapi saya tidak merasa terlalu agresif overtake rider lain dan saya merasa hanya normal overtake," lanjutnya.
